programme.title: Midnight [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The witness who is unable to hear, becomes the serial killer's next target! 'Kyung-mi' who is deaf, was on the way home when she witnessed 'So-jung' bleeding out on the road. In her attempt to help, she becomes the new target of serial killer 'Do-shik.' 'Kyung-mi' runs in desperation and willingness to survive but cannot hear even the murderer's footsteps! During the night, in the middle of Seoul, begins the unstoppable chase between a serial killer and his newest target, 'Kyung-mi'! An extreme silent chase thriller!

programme.title: Firefighters [English Dub]
programme.desc: Even in the harshest environments, firefighters must focus on extinguishing fires and rescuing everyone there. At 3:47 AM on March 4, 2001, the 119 emergency call center receives a phone call about a fire that has broken out in the Hongje-dong neighborhood. Firefighters, including newcomer Cheol-woong, rush to the scene.

Ma and Jeon find out that he gets involved in a kidnap/murder case: the victim is a young businessman whose father is the giant loan shark in Seoul.
